開始之前，先確認這四件事。: Check these four things before you start.
未啟用登入時工作區不分帳號；別人也用這台電腦，就看得到你掃描與取件的檔案。: Without sign-in the workspace is not split by account; anyone else who uses this computer can see the files you scan and retrieve.
服務只開在本機: The service listens only on this computer
安裝時選擇不開放區域網路（服務只接受 <code>127.0.0.1</code: Choose not to open the service to the local network during installation (it then accepts connections only on 127.0.0.1). If it is already open, run sudo jtdt bind 127.0.0.1 (on Windows, run jtdt bind 127.0.0.1 as administrator).
用這台電腦的瀏覽器開: Open it in a browser on this computer
網址是 <code>http://127.0.0.1:8765/tools/mf: The address is http://127.0.0.1:8765/tools/mfp-fetch/. Without sign-in this tool only works locally on this computer; connections from other computers are refused.
跟事務機在同一個內網: On the same internal network as the MFP
這台電腦要連得到事務機的 IP 或主機名稱；本站只連內部網路的位址。: This computer must be able to reach the MFP's IP address or host name; the site only connects to internal network addresses.

工具頁最上方的紅色提醒：服務只開在本機時，提醒確認這台電腦沒有其他人共用；服務開: The red warning at the top of the tool page: when the service listens only on this computer it reminds you to make sure nobody else shares the computer; when the service accepts network connections it warns you directly and gives the command to restrict it to this computer again.

在「新增事務機」輸入 IP 或主機名稱。連線方式選「自動」，HTTPS 443: Under Add an MFP, enter the IP address or host name. Leave the connection method on Auto; when both HTTPS 443 and HTTP 80 work, 443 is used.

未啟用登入時，這個工具只准在裝這套系統的電腦上使用（網址要是 <code>127: Without sign-in this tool only works on the computer where the system is installed (the address must be 127.0.0.1 or localhost). To use it from another computer, enable sign-in first.

If this system runs as a server for several people without sign-in, anyone who can reach the site can see the scanned and retrieved files, so documents containing confidential or personal data are effectively exposed. Enable sign-in first if several people use it.
